subject.title: fix(voice-call): avoid OpenAI realtime double greeting

question: Should this PR wait for live Twilio/OpenAI outbound-call proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-harness proof for this timing-sensitive provider path?
rationale: The code path is plausible and source-tested, but prior review asked for real affected-surface proof and the PR has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide proof sufficiency alone.

options.title: Require live outbound-call proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted current-head Twilio/OpenAI call proof showing one startup greeting and normal later caller audio.

options.title: Accept source-harness proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the mock/source proof and own any live provider/carrier timing issue found after release.

recommendation.title: Require live outbound-call proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted current-head Twilio/OpenAI call proof showing one startup greeting and normal later caller audio.
